title: Signed acquisition is not a completed acquisition

input.section_heading: Notes to Consolidated Condensed Financial Statements
input.chunk_text: In October 2026, we entered into a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Classiq Technologies Ltd. for approximately $1.9 billion, subject to customary purchase price adjustments. The agreement also provides for up to $350 million of contingent consideration based on the achievement of specified performance milestones. The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions. We may elect to settle the purchase price in cash or shares of Company F common stock. We have not yet completed our assessment of the accounting for the transaction.

title: Acquirer does not inherit every target assertion

input.section_heading: ITEM 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA
input.chunk_text: On November 22, 2023, we completed the acquisition of VMware, Inc. (“VMware”) in a cash-and-stock transaction (the “VMware Merger”). The VMware stockholders received approximately $30,788 million in cash and 544 million shares of Company E common stock (on a split adjusted basis) with a fair value of $53,398 million. VMware was a leading provider of multi-cloud services for all applications, enabling digital innovation with enterprise control. We acquired VMware to enhance our infrastructure software capabilities. The accompanying consolidated financial statements include the results of operations of VMware commencing on November 22, 2023. See Note 4. “Acquisitions” for additional information.
